plan.notes: Source: official Cayuga Community College catalog, Computer Science AS program page (catalog.cayuga-cc.edu/2025-2026/degree-programs/computer-scienceas/). Transcription method: full text read of the official program page; transcribed verbatim 2026-09-30. Program description: 'A mathematics and computer programming-based program designed to prepare students for transfer to a bachelor of science degree program.' Academic preparation: three years of high school mathematics required; four years recommended. Catalog total: 64 credit hours; semester subtotals (16+16+16+16) agree exactly with the published 64-credit total. The curriculum page states 'The curriculum listed on this page leads to an AS degree in Computer Science' and that General Education requirements must be met before the AS degree will be granted. Choice-slot footnotes per catalog: (*) Behavioral/Social Sciences — choose one of PSY 101, SOC 101, ECON 201, ECON 202, ANTH 101, GIS 111, GIS 205 (appears in First and Second Semesters; select two different courses). (**) Humanities — choose one: ART 139, 103, 104, 106, 112, 113, 131, 160, 215, 221, 231, 250, 251, 255, 260; MUSI 104, 112, 154, 158; THA 101, 113, 152; PHIL 203. (dagger) Science — must be a two-course sequence chosen from BIOL 103-104, BIOL 225-226, CHEM 103-104, PHYS 103-104, PHYS 200-201, GEOL 110-111; the first course is taken in Third Semester (SCI 1XX) and the matching second course in Fourth Semester (SCI 2XX). Fourth-semester English: ENGL 201-206 (Literature) OR ENGL 221 (Effective Speech: Public Address) OR ENGL 222 (Effective Speech: Group Discussion). Fourth-semester math: MATH 203 (Linear Algebra) OR MATH 210 (Data Structures). DEISJ: Cayuga General Education Diversity/Equity/Inclusion/Social Justice elective (3 cr). No course-level prerequisites are published on the catalog program page; prereq fields are left empty rather than invented.
